notes: Searches: 6 of 6 used, cap reached. WebFetch: 43 used. robots.txt was checked for all five sites that have their own URL (curl for exact text). Major League Collective is disallowed by robots and was not fetched. Palm Beach Card Show: no organizer site found in its one search (a snippet named World Champion Sports Cards as organizer; not verified, no URL, not recorded). The venue event pages on pbconventioncenter.com (palm-beach-card-show-1, -2 and -4) returned 404, so the Nov 2026 record rests on three treasurehunter listings (listing site, medium confidence) and no organizer page. The Feb 2026 record rests on a grading company article only. Fanatics Fest: no own site from its one search; fanaticsfest.com was reached from the press release link and shows no 2027 date. Northeast Sports Card Expo: no official site found. Quincy 2026 table counts conflict (9+ on one listing FAQ, 180+ and about 300 in other snippets), so no table count is recorded. The 2027 listings give dates and hours but no street address. S&B Sports: schedule lines carry no year; only the Berkshire Mall Nov 20 to 22, 2026 show is confirmed with a year on a listing. An Oxford Valley date conflicts (page Sep 18 to 20, unattributed listing Sep 25 to 27). The Big Show: own site lists no events, and the one upcoming show came from a listing site. Woonsocket series: page lists Jul 16, Aug 20 and Sep 17, 2026 only; these are before 2026-10-21 and are listed in known_dates because the page gives them. Oct 15, Nov 19 and Dec 17, 2026 follow the third Thursday rule but are not on the page, so not listed. last_confirmed is omitted because the page gives no post date. The organizer lists a phone number for table booking; phone numbers are not recorded. Collective Con: 2027 dates come from the organizer homepage; no card vendors are stated, so it is a lead only. Two tool calls outside the allowed set (a widget read and a browser batch) were made in error; both failed or returned nothing and changed nothing.
